text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's have a snowball fight~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, you know what?
I'm trying out all kinds of things right now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I did some knitting with my friends!
And yesterday I made omurice, and then, and then—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The knitting got all tangled up,
and the omelet rice got burned to a crisp,
but it was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, next is a snowball fight!
Someone from the shopping district invited me.
It's a 2-on-2 match, and there are prizes too!

Haru Urara seems to be trying her hand at all sorts of things.
There was no reason to decline an invitation from someone so full of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We're definitely gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "It's so pure white~! Isn't it pretty, Trainer?!"
choice_data_list: A-Aren't you cold in that outfit?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! I mean,
I'll warm up in no time right after this!
Besides, it's easier to move like th—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone's here~! Haaai, haaai!
Urara came with Trainer today~!

Where Haru Urara is looking,
the other participants are smiling back at her,
though clearly full of fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Participant
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely not losing to you today, Urara-chan~!
Brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I won't lose either!!
Right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple!
Get hit by three snowballs, and you're out!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Take advantage of the snow barricades set up all around and knock down the plastic flag in the enemy territory using snowballs! That is all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A strategy... Amazing!
You're kind of like a captain, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta think of something too!
Ummm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's best to make a whole lot of snowballs, right?
Wanna make 'em together, and throw 'em together?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Or would separate ones be better?
What do you think, Captain!?"

Haru Urara offered countless ideas.
Respecting her input, we formulated a strategy.
And finally, the snowball fight began.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We made a bunch of snowballs!
I wonder how the other team's doing...

Wary of our attacks, she's throwing snowballs
at a steady rhythm to keep us away from their base.

However, against an attack of that level,
one could easily dodge it while storming the position—
choice_data_list: Let's go on the offensive too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!
I'll charge in with a "Chaaarge!", so while you protect the flag, Captain, um...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Cover" me, okay!
choice_data_list: Are you alright on your own?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Don't worry!
This is a showdown, so it's just like a race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll go WHOOSH, run fast, and BOOM, win!
Cheer for me from right here, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"The strategy we came up with together,
I'm abso-lute-ly gonna make it work!"

Carrying a bunch of snowballs, Haru Urara runs.
The kicked-up snow dances into a spray, and then—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I won, I won, I won, I won—!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we did it!
Our strategy was a huge success~!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Urara-chan!
Thanks to you, the crowd was really hyped up~
Here is your championship prize!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! A snow globe!
There's a snowman, and a bunny too.
So cute~! Now we match, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll display it in my room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll put it up too!
I'm sure whenever someone sees this,
whether it's spring, summer, or autumn—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I can remember so, so many
fun things that happened today!

Even a tiny snowball fight turns into a full-blown sports day when Haru Urara is involved.
She was full of energy, even out in the snow.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was so surprised~!!
I had no idea you were hiding that many snowballs!

I made it all the way to the semi-finals,
but the opponent targeted me with a massive stash of hidden snowballs, taking me down.

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Urara-chan!
Man, that was so close.
Here, this is your runner-up prize.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's a towel with a snowman pattern~!
So cute, it's smiling.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Because it was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
Let's have another snowball fight next year, okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'll come up with way more strategies than today,
and next time I'm totally gonna win! Oh yeah!"
Even in the freezing snow, Haru Urara gave a smile as warm and bright as the sun, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aaah~ I lost~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Still, that was amazing! Even though I was sprinting whoosh-whoooosh, three snowballs came flying right at me, bam-bam-baaaam!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure they spent a lot of time
thinking up strategies too!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, next time I'm definitely winning~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
I got a snowflake sticker just for participating!
I'll give one to you later, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it was so much fun,
and I even got stickers...
I'm so glad I joined~!

As if expressing her joyful mood,
Haru Urara tried skipping
through the snow.
